Key changes include: 1) Introduction of `storage::Permit` to guard subscription writes against concurrent policy changes. 2) Distinct lifecycle methods (`Retire`, `Discard`, `Remove`) to differentiate between rolling updates, cancellations, and explicit uninstalls. 3) Migration of success counters to occur only after successful activation in the maintainer, preventing false positives from failed/cancelled writes. 4) Improved diagnostic reporting for recovery states and bundle availability. 5) Thread-safe storage operations via a dedicated `SequencedTaskRunner` and `storage::Boundary`.",

structuredContent.summary: The diff implements a robust storage transaction model for adblock subscriptions. Key changes include: 1) Introduction of `storage::Permit` to guard subscription writes against concurrent policy changes. 2) Distinct lifecycle methods (`Retire`, `Discard`, `Remove`) to differentiate between rolling updates, cancellations, and explicit uninstalls. 3) Migration of success counters to occur only after successful activation in the maintainer, preventing false positives from failed/cancelled writes. 4) Improved diagnostic reporting for recovery states and bundle availability. 5) Thread-safe storage operations via a dedicated `SequencedTaskRunner` and `storage::Boundary`.
test_gaps: Unit tests for `StoreSubscriptionGuarded` with expired permits are needed.
Integration tests for `Retire` vs `Discard` behavior in the storage layer.
recommended_changes: Ensure `storage::Boundary` is correctly configured for the specific disk I/O requirements of the adblock component.
Verify that `DiscardSubscription` correctly triggers the cleanup of any temporary files if the storage implementation creates them.
